notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Added settings button to the main menu.
For now this allows to adjust sound and music volumes in the game. Ore options might be added in the future.

notes.title: Update.1.3
notes.content:
Update is mostly focused on improving looks of the game and also adds more changes to existing levels.
[list]
[*] 4 new levels and 1 level replaced with something more interesting
[*] added more new hazards and hostile mobs to avoid
[*] added portal objects
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Adding new content to enjoy.
[list]
[*] 12 new stages to beat
[*] New environments and monsters to encounter
[*] increased size of some smallet planets
[*] imporved some planet textures
[/list]
